newsitem.title: USA: Citizens Utilities to combine stock series.
newsitem.headline: Citizens Utilities to combine stock series.

text.p: Citizens Utilities Co on Thursday said its directors had voted to combine the company's Series A and Series B common stock into a single series.

"Since both series now pay stock dividends that are non-taxable upon receipt and are identical in all respects, the need for two series no longer exists," Leonard Tow, the company's chief executive, said.
He added that the mechanics of the stock combination should be completed this summer.
Citizens Utilities provides telecommunications and public utility services.
